gaps.lead: He was sacked for constantly missing deadlines.
gaps.sentence: If he hadn't kept missing deadlines, he ___ sacked.
gaps.explanation: If + past perfect, would(n't) have been + participle.

gaps.lead: I wish I had never told her the secret.
gaps.explanation: wish + past perfect ≈ shouldn't have + participle.

gaps.lead: You must complete the form in ink.
gaps.explanation: must complete → must be completed (modal + be + participle).

gaps.lead: I have never read such a gripping novel.
gaps.sentence: This is ___ I have ever read.
gaps.explanation: 'Never read such a gripping novel' = 'the most gripping novel I have ever read'.

gaps.lead: I haven't seen a better film this year.
gaps.sentence: This is ___ I've seen this year.
gaps.explanation: I haven't seen a better film = this is the best film (that) I've seen.

gaps.lead: He spoke slowly so that the interpreter could follow.
A professional will repair the roof next week.
gaps.explanation: 'Have something done' — arranged service: have the roof repaired.

gaps.lead: They won't allow you to enter without a ticket.
gaps.sentence: You ___ to enter without a ticket.
gaps.explanation: 'They won't allow you' becomes 'you won't be allowed'.
